title: 2011 regulatory capital: equity, eligible debt and deductions
summary: $8,748,360 ownership capital plus $9,000,000 eligible subordinate liabilities, less $1,064,476 nonallowable assets and $578,431 haircuts, gives $16,105,453 adjusted net capital. Deducting $224,902 required capital leaves $15,880,551 excess. Source difference: a separate common-stock table's eleven sector rows sum to $500,977 versus the reported $500,978 subtotal.
limitation: This is the supplied December 31, 2011 regulatory schedule. Regulatory capital differs from members' capital, liquid cash and personal net worth. Deduction magnitudes are plotted as subtraction. The separate $1 common-stock source difference is retained without a balancing entry, adjustment to this bridge or materiality conclusion.
